info.title: FinLover v1 API
info.description: Implemented operations only. Wallet create, list, detail, update, saving-status and delete operations and scheduler (repeating transaction) operations are available on v1. Monthly transaction reads, the transaction and home summaries, category lists, the reports (summary, cash flow, category distribution and running balance) and the current-user endpoint are available. UI mock screens are not API integration.

get.description: Owner and accepted Contributors can read Owner, accepted members and pending invitations (userId/name/email/role/status). Pending invitees cannot access members. Read-only snapshot. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie-authenticated GETs do not require an Origin. Implemented.

get.description: Report summary cards (US8-2): total income, total expense, net cash flow (income minus expense) and the number of transactions in the selected wallets and period. Query: walletIds is a comma-separated list of wallet ids (omitted = every personal wallet the caller owns, the same set Home totals for walletId=all, saving wallets included; empty = 400 fields.walletIds); startDate and endDate are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD calendar days matched against the stored UTC-midnight transaction dates with no timezone conversion (endDate before startDate = 400 fields.endDate). A wallet the caller does not own, a missing wallet or (until Epic 7 wires reports) a shared wallet returns 404. Money is rounded to at most 2 decimal places by the server; a period without transactions returns 200 with zeros or empty lists. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie-authenticated GETs do not require an Origin. Implemented.

parameters.description: Comma-separated wallet ids; omitted means every personal wallet. An empty value is rejected.

parameters.description: First day of the range (inclusive).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Last day of the range (inclusive); must not be before startDate.

get.description: Income and expense per bucket for the cash flow chart (US8-3). Without interval the server uses suggestedInterval: up to 31 days daily, up to 120 days weekly, otherwise monthly; suggestedInterval is always returned. Weeks start on Monday and months on the 1st; the first and last buckets are clipped to the range. Every bucket is returned, empty ones with income 0 and expense 0. Labels: daily YYYY-MM-DD, weekly the bucket start date, monthly YYYY-MM. More than 400 buckets returns 400 fields.interval. Query: walletIds is a comma-separated list of wallet ids (omitted = every personal wallet the caller owns, the same set Home totals for walletId=all, saving wallets included; empty = 400 fields.walletIds); startDate and endDate are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD calendar days matched against the stored UTC-midnight transaction dates with no timezone conversion (endDate before startDate = 400 fields.endDate). A wallet the caller does not own, a missing wallet or (until Epic 7 wires reports) a shared wallet returns 404. Money is rounded to at most 2 decimal places by the server; a period without transactions returns 200 with zeros or empty lists. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie-authenticated GETs do not require an Origin. Implemented.

get.description: Income and expense split by category (US8-4), each with its total and items sorted by amount descending. Transactions without a category count toward the caller's seeded Others of the same type, as on Home; without one, they appear as categoryId null named Other (No Category) with null icon and color. Percentages have one decimal place and add up to exactly 100.0 per type (largest remainder, taken after rows are merged). A type without transactions is { total: 0, items: [] }. get.description: Combined balance of the selected wallets at the end of each day (interval=daily, the default) or week (interval=weekly, Monday start, last point clipped to endDate; each point is dated at its bucket end) for the running balance chart (US8-5). Wallets have no stored opening balance and only transactions change a balance, so openingBalance (the balance before startDate) is the current balance minus the net of every transaction dated on or after startDate, including transactions after endDate. Every point is returned; days without transactions carry the previous balance, which may be negative. closingBalance equals the last point. More than 400 points returns 400 fields.interval. Query: walletIds is a comma-separated list of wallet ids (omitted = every personal wallet the caller owns, the same set Home totals for walletId=all, saving wallets included; empty = 400 fields.walletIds); startDate and endDate are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD calendar days matched against the stored UTC-midnight transaction dates with no timezone conversion (endDate before startDate = 400 fields.endDate). A wallet the caller does not own, a missing wallet or (until Epic 7 wires reports) a shared wallet returns 404. Money is rounded to at most 2 decimal places by the server; a period without transactions returns 200 with zeros or empty lists. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie-authenticated GETs do not require an Origin. Implemented.

get.description: List the caller's schedulers, upcoming first (completed and cancelled last), optionally filtered by wallet or status. Each item has canManage, true for the Creator. Due dates are calendar dates in Asia/Bangkok, posted by a daily job at 00:00 Bangkok time (17:00 UTC). Only the Creator can read or change a scheduler. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie-authenticated GETs do not require an Origin. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

post.description: Create a scheduler that posts a transaction every N days, weeks, months or years (interval up to 365 days, 52 weeks, 60 months or 5 years). End: never, after N transactions (1-1000), on an inclusive endDate, or a span in weeks/months/years that the server converts to endDate (the start period counts as the first, so 5 months is 5 monthly runs). categoryId defaults to the Others category of the type. A start date of today posts the first transaction immediately; a past start date is not back-filled and waits for the next cycle; month-end days clamp (31 Jan, 28 Feb, 31 Mar). Balances may go negative. At most 50 active or paused schedulers per user (409). Due dates are calendar dates in Asia/Bangkok, posted by a daily job at 00:00 Bangkok time (17:00 UTC). Only the Creator can read or change a scheduler. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

get.description: Home page figures for an optional YYYY-MM month (defaulting to the current month in APPLICATION_TIMEZONE) and either every owned personal wallet (walletId=all, the default) or one accessible wallet. When a shared wallet is selected, totals reflect all members' transactions and topCategories is empty. totalBalance sums the scoped wallets' current balances; hasWallets reports whether the caller owns any wallet; savingGoal shows the selected wallet's progress (percent floored to 0–100) when it is a saving wallet with a goal, otherwise null, and is always null for walletId=all. income and expense total the scoped transactions dated in that month; net is income minus expense with status surplus, overspending or even. topCategories lists up to three expense categories by amount spent (ties by name); expenses without a category count toward the seeded expense Others. An invalid walletId returns 400; another user's or a missing wallet returns 404; non-member access to a shared wallet returns 403. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie-authenticated GETs do not require an Origin. Implemented.

parameters.description: all (default) or the id of an owned wallet.
